title: US Senator Warren voices concern over Nvidia's acquisition of Slurm
title_zh: 美国参议员沃伦对英伟达收购 Slurm 表示担忧
summary: U.S. Democratic Senator Elizabeth Warren sent a letter to the U.S. secretaries of the Department of Energy and Department of Defense on Tuesday, questioning them about Nvidia's acquisition ‌of SchedMD, which makes Slurm software.
summary_zh: 美国民主党参议员伊丽莎白·沃伦 (Elizabeth Warren) 周二致信美国能源部和国防部长，询问他们有关 Nvidia 收购 Slurm 软件制造商 SchedMD 的情况。

title: Can Rezolve AI’s (RZLV) Microsoft Foundry Deal Reframe Its Edge In Retail “Commerce Superintelligence”?
title_zh: Rezolve AI (RZLV) 的 Microsoft Foundry 交易能否重塑其在零售“商业超级智能”领域的优势？
summary: Earlier this week, Rezolve AI announced its brainpowa commerce-tuned model suite is now available in Microsoft’s Foundry on Azure, enabling retailers to deploy commerce copilots integrated with Dynamics 365 and Microsoft 365 Copilot.
summary_zh: 本周早些时候，Rezolve AI 宣布其 Brainpowa 商务调整模型套件现已在 Microsoft Azure 上的 Foundry 中提供，使零售商能够部署与 Dynamics 365 和 Microsoft 365 Copilot 集成的商务副驾驶。

title: Oracle (ORCL) Valuation Check After Bloom Energy Deal And Expanding AI Software Push
title_zh: Bloom Energy 交易和扩大人工智能软件推广后，甲骨文 (ORCL) 进行估值检查
summary: Oracle (ORCL) is back in focus after agreeing to buy up to 2.8 gigawatts of Bloom Energy fuel cell power for its AI data centers, alongside a flurry of new AI-driven software capabilities. See our latest analysis for Oracle.
summary_zh: 甲骨文 (ORCL) 同意为其人工智能数据中心购买高达 2.8 吉瓦的 Bloom Energy 燃料电池电力，以及一系列新的人工智能驱动的软件功能，重新成为人们关注的焦点。请参阅我们对 Oracle 的最新分析。

title: Amazon’s $11.6 Billion Globalstar Deal Amps Up Musk Rivalry
title_zh: 亚马逊 116 亿美元的 Globalstar 交易加剧了马斯克的竞争
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Amazon.com Inc.’s $11.6 billion deal to buy Globalstar Inc.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——亚马逊公司 (Amazon.com Inc.) 以 116 亿美元收购 Globalstar Inc.

title: Stock Market Today, April 14: Oracle Jumps on Expanded Bloom Energy Deal
title_zh: 4 月 14 日今日股市：Oracle 因扩大 Bloom Energy 交易而股价上涨
summary: Today, April 14, 2026, investors are weighing a huge fuel-cell power partnership and new AI tools reshaping this cloud giant’s outlook.
summary_zh: 今天，2026 年 4 月 14 日，投资者正在权衡巨大的燃料电池电力合作伙伴关系和重塑这家云巨头前景的新人工智能工具。
